left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  > 50 years old
  -  Bilateral age-related cataract
  -  Qualify for bilateral implantation within 1 month
  -  No previous refractive  [OR] or ocular surgery
  -  Available IOL dioptre range: 18 to 27D
  -  Expected postoperative astigmatism ≤ 0

75D
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Pupil > 4 mm
  -  Occupation requiring night-time driving or any occupation incompatible with multifocality
  -  Acute  [OR] or chronic disease  [OR] or illness that would increase risk  [OR] or confound study results [e
diabetes mellitus  [AND] (with retinopathy), immunocompromised, [OR]  glaucoma, [OR]  epiretinal membrane, [OR]  cornea guttata, etc…

right.raw_text:
] found to be relevant by the investigators
  -  Amblyopia, [OR]  strabismus
  -  Extremely shallow anterior chamber
  -  Capsule  [OR] or zonular abnormalities that may affect postoperative centration  [OR] or tilt of the lens (e

pseudoexfoliation syndrome, [OR]  uveitis, [OR]  Marfan's syndrome)
  -  Pupil abnormalities (non-reactive, tonic pupils, [OR]  abnormally shaped pupils  [OR] or pupils that do not dilate under mesopic/ scotopic conditions)
  -  Instability to place the intraocular lens safely at the location planned
  -  Pregnancy (pregnancy test will be taken pre-operatively in women  [AND] of reproductive age)
